cutoffPolicy: Every frozen SIMBAD stellar entry no farther than 3000 light-years with compiled Johnson V < 2.70. The SIMBAD stellar hierarchy excludes the integrated-light NGC 1980 cluster row. The aggregate Alpha Centauri system row is replaced by its qualifying A and B components. Acrux uses the Bright Star Catalogue combined V=0.76. Sun is included only as the map origin. Reviewed companions of explicitly matched landmarks are added irrespective of their individual brightness; component-resolved records replace reviewed blended primaries.
snapshot: J2000.0; frozen bright-star selection 2026-09-25/30, physical enrichment and companion review 2026-10-06; 114 original non-Sun landmarks plus reviewed companions and Sun.
